title: Test suite silently depends on an untracked $TMPDIR Spotlight-exclusion marker

description:
## What

The Rust test suite depends on `$TMPDIR/.metadata_never_index` existing on macOS. Nothing in the repo creates, checks, or documents this — the marker lives outside version control and does not survive a fresh machine or (apparently) an OS upgrade.

## Why it breaks

The suite creates many small files in `$TMPDIR` (temp git repos, storyhook fixture trees). Without the marker, Spotlight indexes them and `mds_stores` backlogs, starving the fixture-heavy web tests. The resulting slowness widens the readiness race in [[SH-51]] and the failures surface as spurious 404s rather than as anything pointing at the filesystem.

## Extent

Measured on a tree with no Rust changes:

- marker absent: `cargo test --test web_test` failed 57 of 123
- marker restored (`touch "${TMPDIR}.metadata_never_index"`): same suite, same tree, 0-2 failures across five consecutive runs

The diagnosis cost is the real damage — the symptom (404s from a live server) points nowhere near Spotlight.

## Repro

    rm "${TMPDIR}.metadata_never_index"
    cargo test --test web_test

Expect a large block of 404 failures within a few runs.

## Last known good

Unknown. The marker was present historically on this machine and was gone by 2026-07-25, plausibly wiped by the Tahoe 26.5.2 upgrade.

## Fix

Do not depend on ambient machine state. Options, best first:

1. Point the suite at its own scratch root under a directory that is never indexed (`/private/tmp` is not indexed), via a `TempDir::new_in` helper all fixtures go through.
2. Failing that, have the test harness assert the marker exists and create it, so the dependency is explicit and self-healing rather than silent.

Fixing [[SH-51]] reduces the blast radius but does not remove the dependency — the suite would still be slow, just less wrong.

text: [git] e35a433: chore(storyhook): track SH-51, SH-52, SH-53

Fixed in commit 2316ddf (branch rearch/w0-gate-repair, W0.1). Root cause removed rather than documented: web_test.rs no longer creates fixtures under $TMPDIR at all. scratch_root() resolves to /private/tmp on macOS (never Spotlight-indexed) and to the OS temp dir elsewhere; scratch_dir() is now the only way this suite creates a temp directory and all 134 tempdir() call sites go through it. ensure_tmpdir_is_spotlight_exempt() additionally creates $TMPDIR/.metadata_never_index when missing, so the suites still building fixtures there are protected too (they move onto the shared helper when the test-support crate lands in W0.2). Regression test scratch_dirs_live_outside_the_spotlight_indexed_tmpdir asserts fixture paths never start with std::env::temp_dir() and that the marker exists on macOS: red against a passthrough helper (got /var/folders/.../T/.tmpddEaaq), green after. web_test 140/140 in 3.25s. Deliberately minimal so it moves into the test-support crate unchanged.
